bagPolicy.summary: A purse, clutch or bag up to 5 × 7 inches may be opaque; larger bags must be clear and are searched. The venue does not give a maximum dimension for clear bags.
allowed: Purse or clutch up to 5 × 7 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Limited on-site parking costs $15 per vehicle. Larger shows may use the paid garage north of the theater; its price is not set on the venue FAQ. Accessible spaces require a placard or plate.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ mentions light rail and occasional pedal taxis but gives no designated rideshare stop.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Full bars operate in the venue, and pizza is served at most events along with a snack machine. Outside food and drinks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The building is ADA compliant and has limited parking for guests with a valid disability placard or plate. Email the venue for specific accommodations.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is generally prohibited; the venue says staff can make exceptions for special circumstances.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Show the mobile ticket barcode or a printed ticket to enter. If tickets were lost, the box office can resend them on presentation of the purchasing credit card and ID.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: A physical government photo ID is required for age-restricted shows; digital and paper IDs are rejected. All bags are searched at entry; the concert page gives that show’s door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
